content.text:
I couldn't verify any warehouse. Both imagery sources (GSI aerial and Sentinel-2) returned "no imagery source", so every result comes from embeddings alone. My estimate is about 15–30 warehouses, within a range of 15–58. Confidence is low.

- **Resolution and cell size:** I used the synthetic `aef-10m-annual` 2024 index at 160 m cells. That is the finest size available, and it roughly matches a building of 40–100 m. The Clay embeddings start at 1,280 m, which is too coarse for single buildings.
- **Area searched:** The whole AOI (136.82–136.92E, 35.05–35.12N) was scored, which is all 3,430 cells. Nothing was reviewed visually.
- **Method:** I trained a linear probe on the 16 PLATEAU example buildings against random cells. I then kept cells scoring 0.7 or higher and merged touching cells into sites. That gave 58 candidate sites.
- **Count and range:** The 15 sites scoring about 0.87 or higher are my best-supported set, which is the low end of the range. The 58 sites at 0.7 or higher are the high end.
- **Main weakness:** The training examples are PLATEAU buildings, not confirmed warehouses of 1,600 m² or more. The probe therefore finds building-like cells and can't tell warehouses from factories, markets or hangars.
- **Claims recorded:** I recorded only the five highest-scoring sites, each as "present" at 0.3 confidence. All five are ungrounded, since there is no image to cite. They are at (35.0752, 136.8394), (35.0579, 136.9026), (35.0637, 136.8279), (35.0723, 136.8567) and (35.0637, 136.8998). The other 53 candidates are listed in the aggregate result (`r-0026`) but not logged as claims.
- **Not reviewed:** The 3,371 cells below the 0.7 threshold were not examined as candidates.

The limitations are logged with `note_limitation`.
